title: @ycforge/pilot extensions — .ycsf/extensions.yaml schema and EXT_* error code catalog
description: Machine-readable contract for Project C user extensions (spec 015): JSON Schema for the .ycsf/extensions.yaml file (requiring version: 1 and the extensions rule list), the IDL-addressed deep-merge transform layered between dispatch (014) and serialization (014), the ExtensionsDiagnostic shape, and the catalog of EXT_* load/validation error codes. Target identity is the stable IDL domain.name (IDEA §16/§25), resolved via the C-owned side-table IDL_DOMAIN_BY_TF_TYPE.

extensionsYaml.title: .ycsf/extensions.yaml entry
extensionsYaml.description: Formatted contract (Constitution III): version: 1 and the extensions rule list. Exactly two top-level keys are allowed; any other key is rejected (EXT_INVALID, Constitution V — fail-fast over silent ignore). The file is optional in a project; its presence decides the orchestrator (spec 021), not the loader.

version.description: Required. Format version (Constitution III); anything else or absent → EXT_VERSION.

extensions.description: List of extension rules. Empty list is valid (identity no-op). One target declared more than once → EXT_DUPLICATE_TARGET at applyExtensions validation (fail-fast, Constitution V; never sequential merge).

extensionRule.title: One extension rule
extensionRule.description: target — stable logical IDL `domain.name` (two segments [a-z][a-z0-9_]* each, per spec-002 ResourceReference segment grammar); patch — plain-object mapping whose values are a JSON tree (object/array/scalar/null). Content of patch values is NOT validated against provider schema (Constitution IV — terraform validate owns that); only the type-structure needed for deep merge is checked.

target.description: IDL address: domain.name, e.g. functions.user_service. Domain resolved via IDL_DOMAIN_BY_TF_TYPE; a grammatically valid but non-existent domain is NOT a structural error — it yields EXT_UNRESOLVED_TARGET at resolution (conservative toward additive table growth, spec 019).

patch.description: Deep-merge patch applied to resource.configuration (§25.2): recurse iff both sides are plain objects; array/scalar/null from patch replace; new keys added; inputs never mutated. ${...} and {{$ENV}} strings pass byte-for-byte (FR-010/FR-011). Empty object {} is a valid no-op.

extensionsDiagnostic.title: applyExtensions validation diagnostic
extensionsDiagnostic.description: Emitted by the applyExtensions validation phase (EXT_DUPLICATE_TARGET / EXT_UNRESOLVED_TARGET / defensive EXT_INVALID for duplicate IDL in index or non-object configuration of a targeted resource). Structural loader diagnostics (EXT_VERSION/EXT_INVALID) reuse the ProjectModelDiagnostic shape (spec 011) with file/line/column populated; at apply time the transform has no file knowledge, so location fields stay undefined.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic with context (for EXT_UNRESOLVED_TARGET: the target and the alphabetically ordered available IDL list).

file.description: Optional: only populated by the loader for structural ExtensionsDiagnostic-compatible diagnostics.

field.description: Optional: unset unless a specific field is at fault.

line.description: Optional: 1-based line from the YAML parse gate.

column.description: Optional: column from the YAML parse gate.

availableIdls.description: Alphabetically ordered list of IDLs addressable in the generated model (EXT_UNRESOLVED_TARGET only; FR-007).

errorCodes.title: EXT_* error code catalog
errorCodes.description: All extensions load/validation error codes (spec 015). Distinct EXT_* family, separate from PML_* (project-model), BRG_* (plugin-registry) and MTL_* (materializer-dispatch) codes. Compared via constants in src/contracts/extensions.ts, never string literals (Constitution V). No EXT_MERGE_ERROR code exists (deliberately): deep merge is total on JSON trees and cannot fail.

EXT_MISSING_FILE.description: .ycsf/extensions.yaml is absent when loadExtensions is called (FR-002). Throws, never a validation result — symmetric with BRG_MISSING_FILE (013) and spec 011 loadProjectModel. The file is optional; its presence is decided by orchestrator 021.

EXT_VERSION.description: version key absent or not equal to 1 (FR-003, Constitution III).

EXT_INVALID.description: Structural invalidity (FR-004): YAML syntax errors / duplicate YAML keys (parse gate uniqueKeys) / unknown top-level or rule keys / extensions missing or not a list / rule not a mapping / rule keys other than exactly target+patch / target not a string or violating IDL grammar (two segments [a-z][a-z0-9_]*) / patch not a plain-object mapping. Also defensive at applyExtensions validation: duplicate IDL in the generated model index (violation of the one-app-one-resource invariant) and non-object configuration of a targeted resource. Collected for ALL errors (collect-all).

EXT_UNRESOLVED_TARGET.description: target (including a grammatically valid but non-existent domain) matches no generated resource's IDL (FR-007). Message carries the target and the alphabetically ordered list of available IDLs. Resolution errors collected for ALL rules before any patch is applied (all-or-nothing).

EXT_DUPLICATE_TARGET.description: The same target is declared more than once in the file (FR-005). Fail-fast (Constitution V); sequential merge is forbidden because it would make the result order-dependent. Precedents: MTL_COLLISION / MTL_OUTPUT_NAME_COLLISION / PML_DUPLICATE_APP_ID / BRG_KEY_COLLISION.
